build_AttractorLayer: build a python module that creates an AttractorLayer with configurable attractors and bin centers for depth estimation
build_AttractorLayerUnnormed: build a python module that creates an AttractorLayerUnnormed with unbounded bin centers for depth estimation
run_exp_attractor: run the exp_attractor function to compute exponential delta shifts for bin center attraction
run_inv_attractor: run the inv_attractor function to compute inverse delta shifts for bin center attraction
review_AttractorLayer_forward: review the AttractorLayer forward method that computes new normalized and scaled bin centers from features
